The dashboard now prerenders a shell with its heading and section placeholders. The data fetch runs inside a Suspense boundary, so it no longer holds up the shell. I also made the route loading screen use the same placeholders, enabled partial prefetching, and updated the page title.

`npm run build` passes and reports `/` as **Partial Prerender**. I checked the generated HTML and confirmed it contains the heading, placeholders, and streaming boundary.

The existing `https://api.example.com/dashboard` URL still supplies the live values; it needs a working endpoint for the data sections to render.
